workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya Raman's and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are their common 30-minute free slots for next week.

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which slot works for all four of them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. Thanks for the list. I've checked the calendars for Elena and David, and the only time from your list that works for everyone is Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and book the 30-minute meeting for that time. I'll send the confirmation email once it's in the system.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, just checking in. I created the booking for Thursday at 14:30. Have you sent the confirmation email yet?

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, confirmation email has been sent. Great work!

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

The meeting will take place on Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00 Eastern.

Brad
